title: Good-Bye, Heron
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Loner Soji and sociable Mika meet on a school rooftop at 16 and find they both come from unhappy homes (AniList and MangaUpdates blurbs). They drift into an unlabeled relationship without promises, later living together, and the story follows them from their teens into adulthood. A quiet one-volume drama tagged shounen ai.
life_message: Two people who lacked a loving home can become each other's place of rest (to verify).

content.note: Quarreling parents and a difficult childhood (MangaUpdates categories).
Shounen ai genre and MangaDex 'safe' suggest little shown; relationship begins in their teens (to verify).
Loneliness, distant parents and running away (MangaUpdates categories) (to verify).

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Unlabeled same-sex partnership outside family expectations.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Living by feeling, day to day (Mika's outlook).

folkways.japan: The school rooftop meeting and reluctance to speak feelings aloud reflect Japanese norms of reserve and unspoken understanding.
